messages:
noah kim: Hey all, new hire here. Setting up dev box (M2) and running into asdf + brew issues. Hoping for a quick checklist.
riley: Welcome! :wave: Quick Q: which shell are you using? zsh or bash?
noah kim: zsh. Homebrew installed but `brew` is at /opt/homebrew and some tools still pick up /usr/local.
marta g: Put `eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"` in ~/.zprofile so it runs for login shells. Restart terminal after that.
noah kim: Done. Next, asdf fails building node with openssl errors when npm tries native modules.
infra-bot: infra-helper: If you see openssl errors, ensure openssl@1.1 is installed: `brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config`.
riley: Then export flags before running `asdf install`: `export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"` `export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"` `export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"`.
noah kim: That fixed ruby and node builds. But asdf still didn't override the brew node; my `node -v` shows brew node.
marta g: Add `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` in ~/.zshrc after any brew shellenv lines. Then `asdf reshim` and open a new shell.
noah kim: Reshim helped. Also had to `brew unlink node` because brew node shadowed things during installs.
dev-support: For SSH keys, add your public key to `infrastructure/ssh-keys/` in the infra repo and open a PR, or DM us and we'll add it. Dotfiles are in our private dotfiles repo; invite should be in your onboarding email.
noah kim: I didn't get the invite link. Can someone resend?
dev-support: Sent invite. Also FYI we use ~/.local/bin for helper scripts; add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` after asdf in zshrc.
noah kim: Everything green now (node, ruby, yarn, docker). Thanks for the quick help :heart:
riley: Awesome, welcome aboard :tada: Please paste any extra notes into the onboarding doc so future hires benefit.
